detector.name: Nvidia - GPU utilization expected to reach the limit
detector.programText:
A = data('DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL').publish(label='A')
detect((when(A > threshold(90))), auto_resolve_after='2d').publish('Nvidia - GPU utilization expected to reach the limit')

rules.description: The value of DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL is above 90.
rules.detectLabel: Nvidia - GPU utilization expected to reach the limit
